entities.summary: The Indonesia Institute of the Arts Yogyakarta is a state-owned college in Bantul Regency, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia. It teaches visual, performing, and media arts in traditional Indonesian and modern international styles. ISI Yogyakarta was ranked number one in Indonesia on the QS World's Top Performing Arts Schools in 2022. It was founded in 1984 with the merger of the Indonesian College of Fine Arts, the Indonesian Academy of Music, and the Indonesian Dance Academy.
